integrity.limitations: Finite experiments alone do not verify the universal and asymptotic statements. No independent audit or external certification.

scientific_limitations: Not applicable to unrestricted positive integers; sample is uniform on five-smooth integers not logarithmically weighted.
The error term is proved but no sharp secondary oscillatory term is identified.
Priority comparison uses the full 2023 preprint and primary related text; the 2025 publisher full version could not be inspected.
scope_description: First fixed-point hitting times of the Fibonacci rank-of-appearance map, uniformly sampled over five-smooth integers, including exact exponent dynamics and limiting statistics.
title: A limiting hitting-time law for the Fibonacci rank map on five-smooth integers
